correctness.rationale: Write A_e=R⊕Rw with R=k[r]/(r^m−1), char k=2, z=r^{m/2}, w a=bar(a)w and w²=z^e (e=0 dihedral,1 quaternion). Left and right r actions have the same coefficients in both algebras, while L_w and R_w differ only in first-coordinate terms ((1+z)bar b,0) and ((1+z)b,0). For any two-sided ideal I, L_r+R_r applied to (a,b) gives (0,(r+r^{−1})b); since (1+z)=(r+r^{−1})r(r+1)^{m/2−2}, I contains (0,(1+z)b), and applying w to it on left and right yields both difference terms. Therefore stability for both left/right generators in A_e implies stability in A_{1−e}, symmetrically. This works for every characteristic-two field and m=2^h≥4. The basis map is coefficient identity, hence Hamming supports and subspace lattice structure match, without asserting algebra homomorphism. Independently multiplied polynomials modulo r^m−1 over F2 for m=4,8,16,32 and verified divisibility identity. Source checker was read; its m=4, F2 ideal counts are corroboration, not proof for arbitrary fields.
residual_risks: Group order m=2^h is essential; h=1 excluded because exponent m/2−2 negative. The unit group/left-ideal lattice can differ and is not claimed to coincide.

The explicit char-two generator relation proves all-field, all-2-power-order equivalence and yields entire corresponding two-sided code Hamming weight enumerators, not just an arbitrary small example.
